src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/SelfHealingPanel.tsx:69 attempts only ever enter status healing; nothing moves them to healed/failed, and the ledger is session useState, so no confirmed/reverted/unknown outcome exists to learn from
src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/selfHealing.ts:101 the autonomous path is a tier-1 re-queue bounded by the manual max-retries ceiling, and the switch defaults off (SelfHealingPanel.tsx:46)

pairs.registryProposal: Boundary case worth a sentence in the golden path: a surface that labels a pure retry as healing ("Install missing dependencies and retry" while the retry changes nothing) is neither cleanly retry-backoff nor self-healing; the path should say the label itself is the defect (the claim outruns the mechanism), so judges stop splitting it between not-applicable and deviation.
